articles.title: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware affects most servers on planet Earth
articles.content: Critical flaw in EDK2 allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
articles.titleZh: UEFI固件中的代码执行缺陷影响地球上的大多数服务器
articles.contentZh: EDK2中的关键缺陷允许攻击者在引导过程的早期执行代码。

articles.title: Disgraced eMudhra drops out of TLS business after using cert private key of 4
articles.content: Flubbed key signing "ceremony" allowed minting of web credentials for any site.
articles.titleZh: 丢脸的eMudhra在使用4的证书私钥后退出TLS业务
articles.contentZh: 错误的密钥签名“仪式”允许为任何站点铸造Web凭据。

articles.title: 333 Tor exit nodes hijacked to intercept SSH traffic and retrieve plaintext email
articles.content: For 3 days this month, 333 exit nodes were hacked in hopes of stealing sensitive data.
articles.titleZh: 333个Tor出口节点被劫持以拦截SSH流量并检索明文电子邮件
articles.contentZh: 本月3天， 333个出口节点被黑客入侵，希望窃取敏感数据。

articles.title: Enterprises keep buying software upgrades that IT thinks will make things worse
articles.content: Survey of 2,018 IT heads at big firms points to a lack of leverage.
articles.titleZh: 企业不断购买IT认为会使事情变得更糟的软件升级
articles.contentZh: 对大公司2,018名IT主管的调查表明缺乏杠杆作用。

articles.title: The director of Obsession put a new horror short on YouTube
articles.content: Curry Barker, the director behind the hit horror film Obsession, just published a new horror short on YouTube. The short, titled "Mama Bear," is nearly five minutes long. The video is pretty unnerving, and fair warning that it gets a little graphic, but it's a fun one to watch if you're looking for something scary […]

articles.title: Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make
articles.content: During Intel's latest earnings call, CEO Lip-Bu Tan said that demand for its budget-focused Wildcat Lake chips "is outstripping supply."
